ja: 人造人間17号がパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
豊富なオプションパーツが付属し、劇中の多彩なシーンを再現可能！
• 「通常」「怒り」の2種類の表情パーツが付属！
• 拳銃パーツと持ち手が付属！未来で冷酷に暴れまわる17号も再現可能！
• エフェクトパーツも2種類！気功波とバリヤーのエフェクトが付属し、バトルシーンを表現できる！
体内にはドクター・ゲロによって仕込まれた爆弾も内蔵された、こだわりの商品仕様！ 同時発売の人造人間18号と並べて、劇中の印象的なシーンを再現しよう！
en: Android 17 is now available with a renewed package! !
Comes with a wide variety of optional parts, allowing you to recreate a variety of scenes from the movie!
• Two types of facial expression parts are included: "normal " and " angry"!
• Pistol parts and handle included! No. 17, who goes on a ruthless rampage in the future, can also be recreated!
• Two types of effect parts! Comes with Qigong wave and barrier effects, allowing you to express battle scenes!

The product has special specifications, including a bomb planted by Dr. Gero inside its body! Recreate impressive scenes from the movie by placing it side by side with Android 18, which will be released at the same time!

ja: エフェクトパーツ×2（バリヤー、気功波）
en: Gripping hands (left and right) x 1 each
